SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) < CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN (CAST(d_date AS DATE) >= CAST('2001-05-02' AS DATE)) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales
INNER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)
JOIN warehouse ON cs_warehouse_sk = w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item ON cs_item_sk = i_item_sk
JOIN date_dim ON cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
WHERE item.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
    AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-04-02' AS DATE) AND CAST('2001-06-01' AS DATE)
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id LIMIT 100
